lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Answering a Health Inspector About a Bad Lunch
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Give a health inspector a formal, precise account of what was served, when, and what symptoms followed.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the person who filed the complaint, and the AI is Sra. Herrero, the health inspector: give a formal, precise account of what was served and when, using usted and passive se (se sirvió, se recalentó), and share only what Owen agreed to disclose.
lessons.title: Give a Precise Account to a Health Inspector
lessons.objective: Give a health inspector a formal account of what was served, when it was served and which symptoms followed, sharing only what the affected guest agreed to disclose.
lessons.focus: Use formal vous, exact times and passive forms such as a été servi and a été réchauffée to distinguish observations, records and reported symptoms.
lessons.scene: Maya speaks with an inspector about a lunch complaint after her friend Owen agrees to share specified symptoms.

cards.fr: La salade a été servie à treize heures quarante-cinq.
cards.en: The salad was served at one forty-five p.m.

cards.fr: La sauce a été réchauffée devant nous.
cards.en: The sauce was reheated in front of us.

cards.fr: Owen m’a autorisée à décrire ses symptômes.
cards.en: Owen authorized me to describe his symptoms.

cards.fr: Il a eu des nausées, des vomissements et une légère fièvre.
cards.en: He had nausea, vomiting and a slight fever.

cards.fr: Voici le reçu et le formulaire de réclamation.
cards.en: Here are the receipt and complaint form.

reader.speaker: Inspector
reader.fr: Bonjour. Pouvez-vous me dire exactement ce qui a été servi et quand ?
reader.en: Hello. Can you tell me exactly what was served and when?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: La salade au poulet a été servie à treize heures quarante-cinq, selon le reçu.
reader.en: The chicken salad was served at one forty-five p.m., according to the receipt.

reader.speaker: Inspector
reader.fr: Que pouvez-vous dire de la température ?
reader.en: What can you tell me about the temperature?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le poulet était tiède. La sauce a été réchauffée devant nous.
reader.en: The chicken was lukewarm. The sauce was reheated in front of us.

reader.speaker: Inspector
reader.fr: Avez-vous déposé un formulaire ?
reader.en: Did you file a form?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui. Voici le reçu et le formulaire de réclamation déposé au café.
reader.en: Yes. Here are the receipt and complaint form filed at the café.

reader.speaker: Inspector
reader.fr: Puis-je noter ce que votre ami a ressenti ?
reader.en: May I record what your friend experienced?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Owen m’a autorisée à décrire ses symptômes, mais pas à partager son compte rendu médical.
reader.en: Owen authorized me to describe his symptoms, but not to share his medical report.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le soir, il a eu des nausées, des vomissements et une légère fièvre.
reader.en: That evening, he had nausea, vomiting and a slight fever.

reader.speaker: Inspector
reader.fr: Je noterai ces faits et le consentement que vous indiquez.
reader.en: I will record these facts and the consent you describe.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. La salade au poulet a été servie à treize heures quarante-cinq.
speaking.goal: State the service time, observed food temperature and reheating, provide the receipt and form, then report only Owen’s agreed symptoms and withhold his medical report.
speaking.closure: Voilà les faits que je peux confirmer.
wordBank: La salade a été servie à treize heures quarante-cinq.
La sauce a été réchauffée devant nous.
Owen m’a autorisée à décrire ses symptômes.
Il a eu des nausées, des vomissements et une légère fièvre.
Voici le reçu et le formulaire de réclamation.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for nausea.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the direct symptom list.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for consent.

say.cueEnglish: Explain that Owen authorized symptom disclosure.

write.cueEnglish: Write a formal sentence offering the receipt and complaint form.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Qualified French, medical and legal/domain review required for symptom, consent and inspector language. The reported incident is fictional; do not infer a cause of illness or add learner-facing AI medical judgment.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Write a Fair Review After a Mixed Lunch
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Write a balanced online review that describes the food, the service problem and how staff fixed it.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the diner writing a review, and the AI is Kelly, the owner, reading your draft: read out a balanced review of the fish, the long wait and how the staff fixed it, using en primer lugar, sin embargo, además and en resumen, without naming the waiter.
lessons.title: Write a Balanced Review After Lunch
lessons.objective: Write a fair online review describing good food, a long service wait and how staff addressed it, without naming the server.
lessons.focus: Use d’abord, cependant, de plus and en résumé to organize specific praise, a problem and its resolution.
lessons.scene: Maya reads her draft review to café owner Kelly after a mixed lunch.

cards.fr: D’abord, le poisson était frais et bien assaisonné.
cards.en: First, the fish was fresh and well seasoned.

cards.fr: Cependant, nous avons attendu presque une heure.
cards.en: However, we waited almost an hour.

cards.fr: De plus, le personnel s’est excusé et a offert les boissons.
cards.en: Also, the staff apologized and offered the drinks.

cards.fr: En résumé, le repas valait le détour malgré l’attente.
cards.en: In summary, the meal was worth the visit despite the wait.

reader.speaker: Kelly
reader.fr: Vous avez rédigé un avis ?
reader.en: Have you written a review?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui. Je vais vous lire mon brouillon.
reader.en: Yes. I will read you my draft.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: D’abord, le poisson grillé était frais et bien assaisonné.
reader.en: First, the grilled fish was fresh and well seasoned.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: L’accompagnement et l’ambiance m’ont plu.
reader.en: I liked the side dish and the atmosphere.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Cependant, nous avons attendu presque une heure pour le plat principal.
reader.en: However, we waited almost an hour for the main course.

reader.speaker: Kelly
reader.fr: Et comment avez-vous trouvé la réponse de l’équipe ?
reader.en: And how did you find the team’s response?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: De plus, le personnel s’est excusé et a offert les boissons.
reader.en: Also, the staff apologized and offered the drinks.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: En résumé, le repas valait le détour malgré l’attente. Je ne nomme personne dans l’avis.
reader.en: In summary, the meal was worth the visit despite the wait. I do not name anyone in the review.

reader.speaker: Kelly
reader.fr: Merci pour cet avis précis.
reader.en: Thank you for this precise review.

speaking.opening: Je vais vous lire mon avis en ligne.
speaking.goal: Read a balanced review with food praise, the nearly one-hour wait and the staff’s remedy; leave the individual server unnamed.
speaking.closure: En résumé, le repas valait le détour malgré l’attente.
wordBank: D’abord, le poisson était frais et bien assaisonné.
Cependant, nous avons attendu presque une heure.
De plus, le personnel s’est excusé et a offert les boissons.
En résumé, le repas valait le détour malgré l’attente.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for an online review.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the sentence about the long wait.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the staff’s apology and offered drinks.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for value for money.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The meal, wait and staff remedy are fictional. Qualified French review should check written register and connectors.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Rebooking a Group Lunch by Phone and WhatsApp
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Change a group booking by phone and confirm it by text, with polite requests and clear numbers.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the group organizer on a delayed bus, and the AI is Rosa María by phone, then her nephew Edwin on WhatsApp: change the booking from 8 to 5 people and one hour later with ¿sería posible...?, then confirm in writing with le escribo para confirmar and quedo atento.
lessons.title: Rebook a Group Lunch by Phone and Text
lessons.objective: Change a group lunch reservation from eight to five people and from one to two p.m. by phone, then confirm those numbers in a WhatsApp message.
lessons.focus: Use serait-il possible de, je vous écris pour confirmer and clear number repetition across phone and written registers.
lessons.scene: Maya phones a restaurant while her group’s bus is delayed, then sends a WhatsApp confirmation.

cards.fr: Je vous appelle au sujet de notre réservation.
cards.en: I am calling about our reservation.

cards.fr: Serait-il possible de passer de huit à cinq personnes ?
cards.en: Would it be possible to change from eight to five people?

cards.fr: Pourrions-nous arriver à quatorze heures au lieu de treize heures ?
cards.en: Could we arrive at two p.m. instead of one p.m.?
The signal is breaking up; can you hear me?

cards.fr: Je vous écris pour confirmer cinq personnes à quatorze heures.
cards.en: I am writing to confirm five people at two p.m.

cards.fr: Merci de me confirmer le nouvel horaire.
cards.en: Please confirm the new time for me.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Je vous appelle au sujet de notre réservation pour huit personnes à treize heures.
reader.en: Hello. I am calling about our reservation for eight people at one p.m.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Bonjour. Que souhaitez-vous changer ?
reader.en: Hello. What would you like to change?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Notre bus a du retard. Serait-il possible de passer de huit à cinq personnes ?
reader.en: Our bus is delayed. Would it be possible to change from eight to five people?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui, cinq personnes. Et l’heure ?
reader.en: Yes, five people. And the time?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pourrions-nous arriver à quatorze heures au lieu de treize heures ?
reader.en: Could we arrive at two p.m. instead of one p.m.?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui. Le signal coupe ; pouvez-vous confirmer par WhatsApp ?
reader.en: Yes. The signal is breaking up; can you confirm by WhatsApp?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Quel numéro dois-je utiliser ?
reader.en: Of course. What number should I use?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Utilisez le numéro de la réservation.
reader.en: Use the reservation number.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je vous écris : cinq personnes à quatorze heures, vendredi. Merci de me confirmer le nouvel horaire.
reader.en: I am writing: five people at two p.m., Friday. Please confirm the new time for me.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Message reçu. Je confirme cinq personnes à quatorze heures.
reader.en: Message received. I confirm five people at two p.m.

speaking.opening: Je vous appelle au sujet de notre réservation pour huit personnes.
speaking.goal: Request the eight-to-five and one-to-two changes by phone, repeat the exact figures in writing and obtain a confirmation.
speaking.closure: Merci de confirmer cinq personnes à quatorze heures.
wordBank: Je vous appelle au sujet de notre réservation.
Serait-il possible de passer de huit à cinq personnes ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for reservation.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the new two-p.m. arrival question.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for deposit.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether the host can hear during a broken signal.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The reservation, phone number and new time are fictional. Review telephone and text register; no message is actually sent.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Farewell Lunch Plans with the Comedor Owner
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Thank the owner after a week of lunches and set up a farewell meal with clear conditions on menu and timing.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a student in a Spanish class, and the AI is Doña Marta, the comedor owner: thank her for a week of lunches and arrange a Friday farewell lunch for 12, using nos encantaría and siempre que or con tal de que with the subjunctive to set the menu and timing.
lessons.title: Plan a Farewell Lunch with the Owner
lessons.objective: Thank an owner for a week of lunches and arrange a Friday farewell lunch for twelve with clear menu and timing conditions.
lessons.focus: Use nous aimerions, à condition que + subjunctive and conditional requests to state the group size, meat-free meals and timing.
lessons.scene: Maya thanks café owner Marta and asks for a Friday farewell lunch with classmates.

cards.fr: Merci pour cette semaine de déjeuners.
cards.en: Thank you for this week of lunches.

cards.fr: Nous aimerions revenir vendredi avec toute la classe.
cards.en: We would like to come back Friday with the whole class.

cards.fr: Nous serions douze, à condition qu’il y ait de la place.
cards.en: There would be twelve of us, provided there is room.

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous préparer deux plats sans viande ?
cards.en: Could you prepare two meat-free dishes?

cards.fr: Nous les commanderons à condition que la sauce ne contienne pas de bouillon de poulet.
cards.en: We will order them provided the sauce does not contain chicken stock.

cards.fr: Si le repas est prêt à treize heures, nous arriverons à l’heure.
cards.en: If the meal is ready at one p.m., we will arrive on time.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Madame Marta, merci pour cette semaine de déjeuners.
reader.en: Ms. Marta, thank you for this week of lunches.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: C’était un plaisir de vous accueillir.
reader.en: It was a pleasure to welcome you.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous aimerions revenir vendredi avec toute la classe pour un déjeuner d’adieu.
reader.en: We would like to come back Friday with the whole class for a farewell lunch.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Combien de personnes seriez-vous ?
reader.en: How many people would there be?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous serions douze, à condition qu’il y ait de la place.
reader.en: There would be twelve of us, provided there is room.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Oui, j’ai une grande table pour douze.
reader.en: Yes, I have a long table for twelve.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pourriez-vous préparer deux plats sans viande ?
reader.en: Could you prepare two meat-free dishes?

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Oui. Je peux proposer deux plats aux légumes.
reader.en: Yes. I can offer two vegetable dishes.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous les commanderons à condition que la sauce ne contienne pas de bouillon de poulet.
reader.en: We will order them provided the sauce does not contain chicken stock.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Je vais confirmer les ingrédients avec la cuisine. À quelle heure viendrez-vous ?
reader.en: I will confirm the ingredients with the kitchen. At what time will you come?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Si le repas est prêt à treize heures, nous arriverons à l’heure.
reader.en: If the meal is ready at one p.m., we will arrive on time.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Je note douze personnes vendredi à treize heures, sous réserve de confirmer les deux plats.
reader.en: I am noting twelve people Friday at one p.m., subject to confirming the two dishes.

speaking.opening: Merci pour cette semaine de déjeuners.
speaking.goal: Thank the owner, request Friday for twelve at one p.m. and two meat-free dishes without chicken stock, and confirm the outstanding ingredient check.
speaking.closure: Merci. Nous attendons votre confirmation des deux plats.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the direct meat-free dish request.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for chicken stock.

say.cueEnglish: State the sauce condition without chicken stock.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The café and menu arrangements are fictional. Qualified French and food/domain review required for ingredient conditions and subjunctive forms.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Capstone: Hosting a Long Lunch Day in Valparaíso
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Lead a group lunch day from menu to bill: teach, fix a problem, handle a near miss, report and review in Spanish.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the host, and the AI plays guide Patricio, server Ignacio and your friends: lead the lunch from menu to bill and a short review, using si clauses, the subjunctive (antes de que, quiero que), usted with staff and connectors like sin embargo and en resumen.
lessons.title: Lead a Long Lunch from Menu to Review
lessons.objective: Lead a group through a full lunch: explain the menu, choose a substitute, ask about a shellfish allergy, handle a near miss, verify the bill and write a brief review in French.
lessons.focus: Integrate vous with staff, si + present, avant que + subjunctive, clear allergen wording, and cependant/en résumé for the written review.
lessons.scene: Maya hosts three friends at a lunch café; a dish sells out and one guest has a shellfish allergy.

cards.fr: une option sans crustacés ni mollusques
cards.en: an option without crustaceans or mollusks

cards.fr: une allergie aux crustacés et aux mollusques
cards.en: an allergy to crustaceans and mollusks

cards.fr: Si le poisson est épuisé, nous prendrons la tarte.
cards.en: If the fish is sold out, we will have the tart.

cards.fr: Ce plat contient-il des crevettes, d’autres crustacés ou des mollusques ?
cards.en: Does this dish contain shrimp, other crustaceans or mollusks?

cards.fr: Sam a une allergie aux crustacés et aux mollusques.
cards.en: Sam has an allergy to crustaceans and mollusks.

cards.fr: Je veux que vous vérifiiez avec la cuisine avant que Sam ne goûte le plat.
cards.en: I want you to check with the kitchen before Sam tastes the dish.

cards.fr: La note sur la commande mentionne-t-elle l’allergie ?
cards.en: Does the order note mention the allergy?

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous nous donner une addition détaillée ?
cards.en: Can you give us an itemized bill?

cards.fr: Cependant, le personnel a corrigé le supplément.
cards.en: However, the staff corrected the extra charge.

cards.fr: En résumé, le repas était bon malgré ce problème.
cards.en: In summary, the meal was good despite this problem.

cards.fr: Attendez, s’il vous plaît. Sam est allergique et ne peut pas manger ce plat.
cards.en: Wait, please. Sam is allergic and cannot eat this dish.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: La formule du midi comprend une entrée et un plat. Tout le monde a compris ?
reader.en: The fixed-price lunch includes a starter and a main course. Does everyone understand?

reader.speaker: Friend
reader.fr: Oui. Je voudrais le poisson.
reader.en: Yes. I would like the fish.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Le poisson est épuisé.
reader.en: The fish is sold out.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Si le poisson est épuisé, nous prendrons la tarte. Sam a une allergie aux crustacés et aux mollusques.
reader.en: If the fish is sold out, we will have the tart. Sam has an allergy to crustaceans and mollusks.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ce plat contient-il des crevettes, d’autres crustacés ou des mollusques ?
reader.en: Does this dish contain shrimp, other crustaceans or mollusks?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je vais demander à la cuisine.
reader.en: I will ask the kitchen.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Attendez, s’il vous plaît. Sam est allergique et ne peut pas manger ce plat. Pouvez-vous vérifier avec la cuisine avant qu’il n’y goûte et noter son allergie sur la commande ?
reader.en: Wait, please. Sam is allergic and cannot eat this dish. Can you check with the kitchen before he tastes it and note his allergy on the order?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: La note manquait. Je l’ajoute et je vérifie les ingrédients.
reader.en: The note was missing. I am adding it and checking the ingredients.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: La cuisine confirme que cette tarte ne contient ni crustacés ni mollusques.
reader.en: The kitchen confirms that this tart contains neither crustaceans nor mollusks.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Merci. Nous pouvons commander la tarte.
reader.en: Thank you. We can order the tart.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je voudrais signaler au responsable que la note sur l’allergie manquait.
reader.en: I would like to report to the manager that the allergy note was missing.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Je vais consigner ce signalement.
reader.en: I will record this report.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: L’addition contient un supplément que nous n’avons pas demandé. Pouvez-vous nous donner une addition détaillée ?
reader.en: The bill includes an extra charge we did not request. Can you give us an itemized bill?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Vous avez raison. Je retire le supplément.
reader.en: You are right. I will remove the extra charge.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je vais noter les faits dans mon avis : le repas était bon ; cependant, il y a eu un problème de note et de supplément.
reader.en: I will record the facts in my review: the food was good; however, there was a note and extra-charge problem.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: En résumé, le personnel a vérifié les ingrédients et corrigé l’addition.
reader.en: In summary, the staff checked the ingredients and corrected the bill.

speaking.goal: Teach the menu, choose a substitute, state Sam’s shellfish allergy, ask the kitchen and order-note questions, report the missing note to a manager, challenge an extra charge, then give a short balanced review.
speaking.closure: En résumé, le personnel a vérifié les ingrédients et corrigé l’addition.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Qualified French, shellfish-allergy and restaurant/domain review required. The café’s ingredient statement and bill correction are fictional scene facts. Clinical terms remain direct; review notes stay internal.

internalReviewNotes: Master 16–20 preserve the Spanish Master learning purposes with French formal reporting, review, booking, conditional planning and integrated capstone scenes. Direct symptom, chicken-stock and shellfish-allergy terms remain in teaching content.
Qualified French and relevant medical, allergen, privacy and restaurant/domain review remain required; all lessons are private and unregistered.
